inputs.label: Your PSN package of Castlevania: Harmony of Despair for the PS3, USA release (NPUB30505, the .pkg file). The first start builds the game from it, which takes about 20 minutes.
Your licence for the full game (UP0101-NPUB30505_00-CVHDZDLCZUNLOCKZ.rap). Without it the game is installed as the trial.

prepare.label: Building the game from your package: it gets the PS3 firmware's audio decoder from Sony and the build tools, then translates and compiles the game. About 20 minutes.

exit_codes.1: Setting up the game failed. The details are in the setup log in the game's folder.
exit_codes.3: This package isn't the USA PSN release of Castlevania: Harmony of Despair (NPUB30505). Pick that package on the game's page.
exit_codes.4: A download failed (the PS3 firmware from Sony, or the build tools). Check your internet connection and set the game up again.
exit_codes.5: Building the game failed. The details are in the setup log in the game's folder.
exit_codes.6: The licence file (.rap) isn't valid. Pick UP0101-NPUB30505_00-CVHDZDLCZUNLOCKZ.rap again, or leave it out to install the trial.
